title: FancyZones/ImageResizer CLI: report parse errors instead of crashing on non-numeric option values

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The signed MakePri executable is present at the SDK-resolved path; redirecting to another binary is unsupported. Saved command inputs, supporting library, task assembly, expansion target and output parent exist. The missing file is generated XML after Dump returned 0x80070003. Its output path is 262 characters, making path length a concrete discriminator but not a proven cause. The SDK identifier and target conditions do not support extension resolution as causal. One isolated same-input Dump to a shorter unique private output is authorized to measure this discriminator without tracing or changing the SDK; no diagnostic result is yet claimed.
